summary: 2026-27 home kit. Rosneft (the club's general sponsor per cska-hockey.ru/club/partners/) carries the jersey: the РОСНЕФТЬ wordmark across the lower band front and back, the derrick logo on the upper back, and branding on the sleeves. A МИР (NSPK) patch sits on the right chest. Olimpbet is an official partner off the shirt. Sponsor-free: shorts/pants and socks in club photos; the KHL league logo and the hockey-80-years patch are not sponsors; helmets carry СОГАЗ (KHL general partner) stickers, for which the schema has no placement.
